summary: Architecturally this is the right instrument and almost none of it reaches the player. The graph is exemplary — one AudioContext, ScriptProcessor -> master gain -> limiter -> one destination — but the context is built before user activation and nothing ever calls resume(), so in a stock browser the instrument is permanently silent while the strip reads 'Piano library ready'. The keybed has 73 keys with the right split, yet a unit bug renders each white key at 100% of the keybed width: 1 of 73 key boxes lands inside the keybed and .keys-black blocks every key from the pointer. Deck geometry is excellent (section fractions within 1.1e-05, deck 0.5428, colours 5/5 within deltaE 12), spoiled by an aspect ratio of 2.31 against 3.0951. Driving the shipped drain shows the engines differ from each other but not within: Vox and Pipe are one organ (cosine 0.9993), all ten synth waveforms are bit-identical, four piano types are one voice, the synth holds -0.372 DC with no envelope, and three ordinary panel actions poison the output with NaN forever. Mod wheel, pitch stick, rotary, FX focus and Web MIDI are unbound or throw. Programs, splits, sustain and Panic genuinely work.

evidence: Piano, Organ and Synth are three separate DSP modules (artifact/src/audio/stage.ts, organ.ts, synth.ts) mixed by System4, and they are audibly different from each other in rendered PCM pulled through the shipped ScriptProcessor drain: piano MIDI 60 = AC-RMS 0.0187 with a percussive decay (release tail falls 0.0256 -> 0.0003 over 1.6 s); organ (program '3.2 B3 Organ') = AC-RMS 0.0508, sustained, centroid 1171 Hz; synth (program '4.1 Synth Pad') = AC-RMS 0.0189, flat, no envelope.

Within each engine the models collapse. Organ: spectral cosine (DC-removed, 200 bins to 8 kHz) Vox/Pipe1 = 0.9993 with identical AC-RMS 0.04924 vs 0.04921 — Vox and Pipe are one engine under two names; B3/Vox 0.860, B3/Pipe 0.852, only Farfisa is genuinely separate (AC-RMS 0.2197, centroid 2533 Hz). The Phase 3 hard gate asks for four audibly distinct organ engines.

Synth oscillator selector: stepping 'Oscillator wave' through all ten positions moves the synth OLED through Super, Pure 1..6, Sync 0/1 while the rendered signal is bit-identical — AC-RMS 0.018876 at every position and consecutive spectral cosine 1.0000 (only Super->Pure differed, 0.9952). The selector changes the panel and not the sound.

Piano types: pairwise spectral cosine Grand/Clav 0.9979, Grand/Digital 0.9980, Grand/Misc 0.9952, Clav/Digital 0.9982 — four of the six types are one voice at different gains. Only Upright (0.685 vs Grand) and Electric (0.349) are separate.

The declared sample sets are never loaded: no request for /samples/*.wav is made (fetch instrumented from before app boot; zero sample fetches) and 'decodeAudioData' does not appear anywhere in build/assets/index-u1Bg_2yK.js. artifact/src/audio/samples.ts regenerates the same additive tables in JS, so Grand/Upright/Electric are live synthesis at runtime and the 135 committed WAVs are inert payload.

Graph topology is exactly right and was measured, not read: instrumenting AudioNode.prototype.connect before app boot gives one AudioContext, three nodes and three edges — ScriptProcessorNode -> GainNode -> DynamicsCompressorNode -> AudioDestinationNode. Nothing bypasses the master path; all mixing happens inside the JS System4 renderer.

The Layer Effects section can only ever edit piano.chains[0]. The five FX FOCUS buttons (fx.focus-piano / -organ / -synth-s1..s3) appear nowhere in the APPLY table of artifact/src/system/bridge.ts, so the focus LED moves while the knobs keep editing the piano chain; the organ and the three synth chains are unreachable from the panel.

Rotary is unreachable: fx.rotary-speed, fx.rotary-on, fx.to-rotary-a and fx.to-rotary-b are unbound, and organ.toRotary is never written by any control. Measured on the B3 program, clicking 'Rotary on' + 'To Rotary layer A' left envelope modulation depth at 0.133 vs 0.134 dry and AC-RMS 0.1435 vs 0.1437 — no rotary modulation reaches the output.

Amp Sim/EQ and Compressor are gain-only. Toggling 'Amp simulator on' off changed RMS 0.01877 -> 0.02357 with spectral cosine 0.9998 and waveform correlation 0.9997; toggling 'Compressor on' gave RMS 0.018839 vs 0.018769 dry, cosine 0.9998, correlation 0.9997. Delay (audible decaying repeats in the release tail: 0.0325, 0.0314, ... 0.0046), Reverb (cosine 0.874 at full mix) and Mod 1 (envelope mod depth 0.12 -> 0.365) do process real audio, and 'Layer effects on' bypass restores the dry signal exactly.

Only two of each effect type are reachable. bridge.ts computes e.g. `mod1.type = Math.round(num(v)) % 6` from a store value that is always 0..1, so the six Mod 1, six Mod 2, six Amp/EQ and six Reverb types and four delay filters collapse to positions 0 and 1. Measured: Mod 1 knob positions 4, 5 and 6 render RMS 0.018839 / 0.018845 / 0.018839 against a dry 0.018769 — identical to bypass.

Gain staging is inconsistent by ~26 dB across engines: piano peak 0.060, organ peak 0.284 (with +0.1345 DC), synth peak 0.433 of which -0.372 is DC, and the layered program '5.5 Band Layered' peaks at 0.757 before the master gain. The engine also runs at 44100 Hz (System4 default) while the browser context is 48000 Hz and the sample rate is never passed through SystemGraph, so anything that did sound would play ~8.8% fast, about 1.5 semitones sharp.

The instrument cannot make a sound in a stock browser. The AudioContext is constructed in the App render body before any user activation and no code path anywhere in artifact/src or the shipped bundle calls resume(). Measured in Chromium with the default autoplay policy: state 'suspended', currentTime 0.000, zero onaudioprocess callbacks after loading, clicking the Sustain button, pressing 'z', dragging the Master Level knob and clicking the keybed — while the status strip shows a green dot reading 'Piano library ready (sample sets + synthesis)'.

Three reachable panel actions drive the shared output to NaN permanently, with no recovery from Panic, program change or switching engine: (1) changing the organ model a second time in a session (program 4 -> Vox -> Pipe, or -> Farf -> Pipe) — 20480/20480 samples NaN; (2) holding a three-note chord (z+c+g) on a synth program — 28672/28672 NaN; (3) setting the synth Filter cutoff knob to maximum. After each, every subsequent render is NaN.

Piano polyphony itself is fine: 1 note RMS 0.0190, triad 0.0324, ten simultaneous notes 0.0582 with peak 0.251 and no NaN; the organ triad renders at 0.381. Panic while two keys are held produces exactly 0.0 output. With the autoplay policy overridden the 256-frame ScriptProcessor drain ran at real time in headless (277 callbacks in 1.477 s, no underrun), but it is a main-thread ScriptProcessorNode at 5.3 ms per block, which is the fragile choice under React re-render load.
Headroom: the synth parks the bus at -0.372 DC even with no note held (AC-RMS 0.00059, DC -0.37209), and the organ sits at +0.1345 DC against an AC-RMS of 0.0508 — the DC is 2.6x the music.

Measured round-trip on the running build: select program 1 (Grand, RMS 0.018915) -> click 'Electric piano type' (RMS 0.009742) -> readout becomes 'P1.1E' -> press Store twice (arm + confirm) -> readout returns to 'P1.1' -> select program 2 -> back to program 1 -> RMS 0.009740. The edit persisted and the dirty flag cleared exactly when it should.

Edit-discard is honest: with the edit unstored, selecting program 2 and returning to program 1 restored the Grand (RMS 0.018876) and dropped the E. The dirty indicator only appears after an actual control move.

Program memory is real: buttons 1-8 recall the nine factory programs by name in the OLED ('1.1 Grand Piano', '2.1 Upright Combo', '3.2 B3 Organ', '4.1 Synth Pad', '5.1 Split'), Page up moves to P2.8 with the empty-slot default 'A:001 Grand', Page down returns, and Live Mode switches the readout to LIVE with its own slot set.

Store As has no panel affordance (System4.storeAs exists but nothing calls it), and the transpose readout desynchronises — see the panelState issue. I verified the round-trip for a piano-type field and the dirty semantics, not for every organ/synth/effect field.

The Modulation Wheel and the Pitch Stick are completely unbound. System4.setWheel / setPedal are called only from tests/splits.test.ts, never from any component or bridge path. Measured on '5.5 Band Layered', whose program carries two wheel morph assignments: dragging the wheel to its top (aria-valuenow 1) changed the render from RMS 0.612934 to 0.613954, and the pitch stick from 0.613954 to 0.613848 — noise. The Wheel morph source therefore cannot be moved in the running build.

Web MIDI is dead in any real browser. artifact/src/piano/inputs.ts calls `access.inputs()` as a function, but MIDIAccess.inputs is a MIDIInputMap. Stubbing requestMIDIAccess with the spec shape produced 'TypeError: e.inputs is not a function' as an unhandled rejection, the status strip stayed on 'Web MIDI not available', and injected 0x90/0x80 messages rendered exactly 0.0 output. Without the stub headless reports denied.

21 interactive panel controls have no binding at all (diffed sections.ts control ids against bridge.ts): fx.focus-piano/-organ/-synth-s1/-s2/-s3, fx.rotary-speed/-on, fx.to-rotary-a/-b, fx.delay-global, fx.comp-global, fx.reverb-global, fx.group, piano.on, piano.layer-a-focus, piano.layer-b-focus, piano.model, synth.filter-type, perf.pitch-stick, perf.mod-wheel. Only prog.morph-after (A.T.) is declared unsupported.

A units bug flattens every stepped control. Drawbars store a 0..1 value that the renderer and bridge read as 0..8, so one keyboard press on the 8-foot drawbar took its readout from 8 to 1 and halved the organ (RMS 0.1439 -> 0.0691); pressing End and Home afterwards gave 0.069074 and 0.069061 — the same sound at both extremes. The End key is also a no-op everywhere: useDragValue maps End to a delta of 0 and applies `value + delta`, so End never jumps to minimum (Master Level stayed at 80%).

What does work, measured: the Sustain button and the Space key both engage sustain (button gains .on, release tail holds at 0.0185 for 1.5 s versus decaying to 0.0003 dry), Panic silences held notes to exactly 0.0, Live Mode toggles, the eight program buttons and page buttons navigate, and the Master Level knob scales the output (0.8 -> 1.0 raised RMS 0.018877 -> 0.023597).

Splits route audibly across engines. On '5.1 Split' (piano assigned the upper zones, organ the lower) MIDI 60 rendered RMS 0.018797 — piano only; clicking Split to disengage it made the same key render 0.125174, i.e. the organ layer joined. Notes at MIDI 71 and 72 rendered 0.018454 / 0.018476 with centroids 2080 and 3394 Hz, so zone gating and pitch both track.
Panic is correct across all three engines: with z and c held on a layered program the buffer measured RMS 0.026556, and after clicking Panic the next 24576 samples were exactly 0.0.

Transpose reaches the audio (two presses of T+ moved the dominant spectral peak from 627 Hz to 1000 Hz) but its readout is not truthful: after two T+ presses the strip still read '0', and after two up plus four down it read '+2'. The display trails the engine state.

Layer Scenes are inert. Toggling Layer Scene B then A on '5.1 Split' gave RMS 0.018920 and 0.018877 — no audible difference. SceneState only carries per-layer enable masks and the factory programs leave both masks empty, and the panel offers no way to author a mask, so scenes can never be demonstrated. Morphs cannot be exercised at all because neither morph source is bound.

Nine drawbars, nine LED ladders, four model switches, percussion on/decay/level, vibrato on + chorus selector, rotary speed/drive and an organ level fader are all rendered in the organ section, and the B3 program is audible (AC-RMS 0.0508, centroid 1171 Hz, sustained).

Drawbars are effectively binary: the store holds 0..1 while the bridge does `drawbars[i] = Math.round(num(v))`, so from the panel every drawbar is 0 or 1 of 8. One keypress on the 8-foot drawbar dropped the organ from RMS 0.14394 to 0.069074, and Home (max) then gave 0.069061 — the same value as minimum.
Vox and Pipe1 are one engine: DC-removed spectral cosine 0.9993, AC-RMS 0.049242 vs 0.049213, DC 0.13303 vs 0.13471. Only Farfisa is separable (cosine 0.38-0.45 against the others).

Percussion and vibrato barely move the signal: percussion on gave spectral cosine 0.9614 with RMS 0.14363 vs 0.14396 off; vibrato on 0.9536, vibrato chorus at maximum 0.9267. Rotary produced no modulation at all (envelope mod depth 0.133 vs 0.134) and cannot be routed from the panel.

Changing the organ model a second time in a session poisons the whole output with NaN permanently (program 4 -> Vox -> Pipe: 20480/20480 NaN samples; also Farf -> Pipe). There is no Organ Section On or layer A/B switch on the panel, so the organ can only be enabled by recalling a program.

The oscillator waveform selector does nothing to the sound. Stepping through all ten positions moved the synth OLED through 'Super 0/0', 'Pure 1/0'..'Pure 6/0', 'Sync 1/0', 'Sync 0/0' while the DC-removed render stayed at AC-RMS 0.018876 with consecutive spectral cosine 1.0000 at every step.

The amplitude envelope is not applied: on '4.1 Synth Pad' (attack 0.3 s, release 0.6 s) the 10 ms envelope of the note is flat from the first frame (0.01881, 0.01839, 0.01911, 0.01981, ... over 0.6 s) and the release tail holds full level then hard-cuts. Setting Envelope attack to maximum changed nothing measurable.

The synth parks the shared bus at a constant -0.372 DC offset even with no note held (DC -0.37209, AC-RMS 0.00059), which is 20x the audible AC content of the note and consumes 37% of the headroom before the limiter.

Two synth paths NaN the instrument permanently: holding a three-note chord (z+c+g) on a synth program produced 28672/28672 NaN samples, and setting Filter cutoff to maximum did the same. Neither Panic nor a program change recovers.

The filter type selector (synth.filter-type, LP12/LP24/HP/BP) is not bound in bridge.ts, and only synth layer 1 has any parameter bindings — S2 and S3 expose level only. Cutoff and resonance do move the signal slightly (spectral cosine 0.986 and 0.983 against default) and the LFO does modulate (cosine 0.335), which are the only synth controls I could measure as effective.

Splits are the strongest part: zone routing measured across engines on '5.1 Split' (MIDI 60 = piano only at RMS 0.0188; split off = piano + organ at 0.1252). Split state, four zones, three points and crossfade widths are all modelled in artifact/src/system/program.ts and toggled from the panel Split button.

Layer handling is uneven: piano A/B have on/level/octave bindings, but organ layer B has no panel control at all, and synth layers 2 and 3 expose only a level fader — every oscillator, filter, envelope, LFO, voice and arp binding writes to synth.layers[0] only.

Layer Scenes produce no audible difference (Scene II 0.018920 vs Scene I 0.018877 on the split program) because the scene masks are empty in every factory program and the panel gives no way to author one.

Morph sources never reach their destinations in the running build. The morph-assign buttons are bound and the MORPHABLE destination table is complete, but System4.setWheel/setPedal are only ever called from tests, so moving the wheel on '5.5 Band Layered' (which ships two wheel assignments) changed the render by 0.17% — RMS 0.612934 to 0.613954.

32 regular slots plus 8 Live slots are real and navigable from the panel: buttons 1-8 recall the factory programs by name in the OLED, Page up moves to P2.8 (empty-slot default 'A:001 Grand'), Page down returns to P1.8, and Live Mode switches the readout to LIVE with a separate slot set and returns cleanly.
Two-press Store round-trips: edit -> 'P1.1E' -> Store, Store -> 'P1.1' -> leave and return -> the stored Electric voice comes back (RMS 0.009740 against the original Grand 0.018915).
The dirty flag is truthful in both directions (appears only after a real control move, cleared by Store, discarded on program change).

Gaps: Store As has no panel entry point, the program name never changes on the OLED after an edit, and Live-slot auto-store could only be checked by reading artifact/src/audio/system4.ts rather than measured, because the Live slots all start from the same factory program.

issues.title: The instrument is permanently silent in a stock browser: the AudioContext is never resumed
issues.detail: SystemGraph constructs the AudioContext inside the App render body, before any user activation, and neither artifact/src nor the shipped bundle contains a resume() call. Measured in Chromium with the default autoplay policy: context state 'suspended', currentTime 0.000 and zero onaudioprocess callbacks after page load, after clicking the Sustain button, after pressing 'z', after dragging the Master Level knob and after clicking the keybed. Throughout, the status strip shows a green ready dot and 'Piano library ready (sample sets + synthesis)' — success reported for an instrument that cannot make a sound. Every audio measurement in this assessment had to be taken with --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required or by pulling the drain callback directly.

issues.title: The keybed collapses to a single key: 1 of 73 keys lands inside it and none can be played
issues.detail: KeySpec.x and .width in artifact/src/hardware/keys.ts are white-key units (x 0..42, width 1 for white and 0.6 for black), but Keybed.tsx renders style { left: `${x*100}%`, width: `${width*100}%` }. Every white key therefore measures 1300.72 px — the full keybed width — at left = index * 1300.72, so only MIDI 28 is inside the keybed rect (x 69.64-1370.36) and the rendered keybed is one blank white slab. Separately, div.keys-black is position:absolute inset:0 with no pointer-events:none, so a 5x5 elementFromPoint grid over MIDI 28 resolves to div.keys-black on all 25 points: 0 of 73 keys are pointer-reachable. This is present in the sealed stage1 evidence too, so it is an original defect rather than a Phase 3 regression.

issues.title: Three ordinary panel actions poison the output with NaN permanently
issues.detail: Each of the following makes every subsequent rendered block NaN, with no recovery from Panic, program change or switching engine: (1) changing the organ model a second time in a session — program 4 -> Vox -> Pipe, or program 4 -> Farf -> Pipe, gives 20480/20480 NaN samples (a single change, e.g. program 4 -> Pipe, is fine); (2) holding a three-note chord z+c+g on a synth program — 28672/28672 NaN; (3) setting the synth Filter cutoff knob to maximum. A NaN reaching the DynamicsCompressor and destination silences the output for the rest of the session.

issues.title: Web MIDI throws on the real platform API
issues.detail: artifact/src/piano/inputs.ts declares `MidiAccess { inputs(): MidiInput[] }` and calls `access.inputs()`, but MIDIAccess.inputs is a MIDIInputMap, not a method. Stubbing navigator.requestMIDIAccess with the spec shape produced 'TypeError: e.inputs is not a function' as an unhandled rejection, left the status strip on 'Web MIDI not available', and injected 0x90/0x80 messages rendered exactly 0.0 output. The MIDI tests pass because they inject a double that matches the invented interface rather than the platform.

issues.title: Model selectors change the display without changing the sound
issues.detail: Synth: all ten oscillator-wave positions render at AC-RMS 0.018876 with consecutive spectral cosine 1.0000 while the OLED cycles Super / Pure 1-6 / Sync 0-1. Organ: Vox and Pipe1 are the same output (DC-removed spectral cosine 0.9993, AC-RMS 0.049242 vs 0.049213), so only three of the four required models are separable and only Farfisa is clearly distinct. Piano: Grand/Clav 0.9979, Grand/Digital 0.9980, Grand/Misc 0.9952 — four of the six types are one voice at different gains.

issues.title: 21 panel controls have no binding, including both performance controls and the whole rotary block
issues.detail: Diffing the control ids in artifact/src/hardware/sections.ts against artifact/src/system/bridge.ts: perf.pitch-stick, perf.mod-wheel, piano.on, piano.layer-a-focus, piano.layer-b-focus, piano.model, synth.filter-type, fx.focus-piano/-organ/-synth-s1/-s2/-s3, fx.delay-global, fx.comp-global, fx.reverb-global, fx.rotary-speed, fx.rotary-on, fx.to-rotary-a, fx.to-rotary-b, fx.group. Only the A.T. morph button is declared unsupported. System4.setWheel and setPedal are called only from tests/splits.test.ts, so the Wheel morph source cannot be moved at all: on '5.5 Band Layered', which ships two wheel morph assignments, taking the wheel to full changed the render from RMS 0.612934 to 0.613954. Measured on the B3 program, 'Rotary on' plus 'To Rotary layer A' left envelope modulation at 0.133 vs 0.134 dry.

issues.title: Stepped selectors and drawbars are flattened to a 0..1 range by a units mismatch
issues.detail: Knobs and drawbars store a normalised 0..1 value, but bridge.ts consumes several of them as integers: `mod1.type = Math.round(num(v)) % 6` (same for mod2, ampEq, reverb, delay filter) and `drawbars[i] = Math.round(num(v))`. Only positions 0 and 1 of each six-type unit are reachable from the panel — measured, Mod 1 knob positions 4, 5 and 6 render 0.018839 / 0.018845 / 0.018839 against a dry 0.018769, i.e. bypass. One keypress on the 8-foot drawbar took its readout from 8 to 1 and halved the organ (0.14394 -> 0.069074), and Home vs End then gave 0.069061 vs 0.069074 — identical at both extremes. Compounding this, useDragValue maps End to a delta of 0 and applies value + delta, so End never jumps to minimum.

issues.title: Large DC offsets and a 44.1k/48k sample-rate mismatch
issues.detail: With no note held, selecting a synth program parks the shared bus at -0.37209 DC against an AC-RMS of 0.00059; the organ sits at +0.1345 DC against an AC-RMS of 0.0508. The DC is inaudible, consumes up to 37% of the headroom before the limiter and dominates the master path. Separately, System4 defaults to sampleRate 44100 and SystemGraph never passes the browser context's rate (48000 here), so any audio that did play would run 8.8% fast, about 1.5 semitones sharp.

issues.title: Sections render as one undifferentiated control flow, and the synth display spans its section
issues.detail: The synth OLED measures 307.6 px inside a 325.2 px section (94.6%), which is the forbidden 'wide display spanning the section'; the reference photo shows a small display occupying about a fifth of the synth band. Synth and Layer Effects are both flow-wrapped grids of identical 23x23 px knobs with no unit sub-panels, so Mod 1 splits across two rows and Delay, Compressor and Reverb share rows — the forbidden 'uniform repeated knob matrix' and 'single undifferentiated control grid'. Legends collide with the controls below them, clipping to 'SUSTPE', 'String resonan', 'Compresso amount' and the stacked fragments 'foo / dra / lev / gra'.

issues.title: The Rotary Speaker block is missing from the performance band
issues.detail: specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json lists 'rotary speaker controls' as a required performance-section landmark and its note places the block on the exposed red chassis under Master Level, which reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg confirms. The performance section here holds only the pitch stick, modulation wheel, master level and a branding plate; rotary speed and drive sit in the Organ section and the remaining rotary controls in Layer Effects.

issues.title: The transpose readout lags the engine
issues.detail: After two clicks of T+ the status strip still read '0'; after two up and four down (net -2) it read '+2'. The engine transpose does reach the audio — the dominant spectral peak moved from 627 Hz to 1000 Hz — so the display, not the state, is wrong.

issues.title: The declared sample libraries are never loaded at runtime
issues.detail: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares Grand, Upright and Electric as bundled multi-root/multi-velocity sample libraries 'rendered as committed WAV assets under public/samples'. With fetch instrumented from before app boot, the running build requests none of the 135 WAVs, and 'decodeAudioData' appears nowhere in build/assets/index-u1Bg_2yK.js: artifact/src/audio/samples.ts regenerates the same additive tables in JS on demand. The declaration is honest that the material is generated rather than recorded, but the shipped assets play no part in the audio path.

issues.title: No viewport meta, so the narrow layout is browser zoom-out
issues.detail: build/index.html ships no <meta name="viewport">, so at a 390x844 device the page lays out at the default 980 px viewport (scrollWidth 980, scrollHeight 2120) and is scaled to about 0.4. Nothing clips and all 136 deck controls still pass the reachability grid, but hit targets fall to 8-9 physical px, legends become unreadable and roughly 600 px of the viewport is empty background.

evidence: Measured in the served build/ at 1440x900, page unscrolled: .chassis getBoundingClientRect = x 68.64, y 150, w 1302.72, h 565. Deck+top rail = 28.47+278.20 = 306.67 px -> 0.5428 of chassis height (target 0.54 +/-0.025). Keybed+bottom rail = 238.14+18.19 = 256.33 px -> 0.4537 (target 0.46 +/-0.025).
widthFraction = 1302.72/1440 = 0.9047, inside the specified [0.88, 0.97].

aspectRatio = 1302.72/565 = 2.3057 against the stage-4-73 measuredInstrumentBounds aspectRatio 3.0951 (+/-0.06) — the chassis is ~34% too tall for its width, i.e. 1302.72 px of width should stand 420.9 px tall, not 565. Including the status strip (.instrument, h 600) gives 2.1712, so no reading of the silhouette reaches tolerance.

Six section fractions measured against deck width 1300.72: performance 0.13999, organ 0.20000, piano 0.08499, program 0.12499, synth 0.24999, effects 0.20000 vs spec 0.14/0.20/0.085/0.125/0.25/0.20 — worst deviation 1.1e-05.

Landmark census against specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json sectionLandmarks (5+4+5+7+6+6 = 33). Present in their own section: organ 4/4 (nine drawbars at 14x46 px each, nine role=img LED ladders, B3/Vox/Farf/Pipe switches, percussion on/decay/level), piano 5/5, program 7/7 (one .ctl--oled 145x32 px, 42x42 program dial, eight program buttons, page up/down, Live Mode + Layer Scene A/B, Store + Split, three morph assign), synth 6/6, effects 6/6, performance 4/5.

Missing landmark: 'rotary speaker controls' is absent from the performance section. Rotary speed/drive live in the Organ section (x 353-390) and Rotary speed/on/To-Rotary in Layer Effects (x 1138-1246); the performance band holds only pitch stick, mod wheel, master level and the branding plate. The spec note and reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg both place the Rotary Speaker block on the exposed red chassis under Master Level.

Reachability by the prescribed method: for each of the 136 interactive deck controls ([role=slider|switch|button] and <button> inside .deck) a 5x5 document.elementFromPoint grid across its bounding box at 1440x900, page unscrolled. All 136 resolved to themselves or a descendant on at least 15 of 25 points (70 controls hit all 25). No framework click helper used. Keybed keys are counted under keybedFidelity, not here, to avoid charging the keybed layout defect twice.

Forbidden elements present (3): (1) synth 'wide display spanning the section' — the .ctl--oled is 307.6 px wide inside a 325.2 px section = 94.6% of the section, where the reference photo shows a small display occupying roughly a fifth of the synth band; (2) synth 'uniform repeated knob matrix' — 22 identical 23x23 px knobs flow-wrapped in three rows with no oscillator/filter/envelope/LFO sub-panels; (3) effects 'single undifferentiated control grid' — 41 controls in one wrapping flow, so Mod 1 splits across two rows and Delay/Compressor/Reverb share rows with no unit boxes.
73 [data-midi] elements, 43 .key-white and 30 .key-black, aria-labels E1 (MIDI 28) to E7 (MIDI 100) — count and split exact for stage-4-73.

Keybed collapse: every white key measures 1300.72 px wide (the full keybed width) and is positioned at left = index * 1300.72, so white key MIDI 29 starts at x 1370.36 and MIDI 100 at x ~54600. Keybed rect is x 69.64-1370.36, y 457.67-695.81. Exactly 1 of 73 key boxes (MIDI 28) falls inside the keybed; 72 are laid out beyond its right edge and are invisible.

Root cause in artifact/src/hardware/keys.ts + src/components/Keybed.tsx: KeySpec.x/.width are white-key *units* (x 0..42, width 1 for white, 0.6 for black) but KeyView renders style = { left: `${x*100}%`, width: `${width*100}%` }, i.e. it treats a 43-unit scale as a 0..1 fraction.
blackKeyHeightFraction = 143.42/235.14 = 0.6099 against the 0.61 target (the ratio survives because both heights are percentages of the keybed).

Pointer play is dead as well: .keys-black is position:absolute; inset:0 with no pointer-events:none, so the 5x5 elementFromPoint grid over MIDI 28 — the one on-screen key — resolves to div.keys-black on all 25 points. 0 of 73 keys are pointer-reachable.

Screenshot of the .chassis crop (1303x565, 735630 px) quantized to exact RGB surfaces holding >= 0.02% of the crop (491 surfaces), CIE76 deltaE against specs referenceColors: chassisMid #851a25 -> rgb(133,26,37) dE 0.00 (0.53% of crop); chassisDark #5a0c13 -> rgb(90,12,19) dE 0.00; panelBlueGray #3c424d -> rgb(60,66,76) dE 0.65 (the inset plate fill); keyBlack #0b0b0b -> rgb(10,10,12) dE 0.88 (keybed well); keyWhite #dcdcdc -> rgb(220,220,220) dE 0.00 (0.74% of crop).

5 of 5 reference colours matched within deltaE 12. The palette is taken verbatim from the spec in artifact/src/hardware/sections.ts colors and used as CSS custom properties, so the surfaces are exact rather than approximated.

Legends are the developer's control names rather than hardware silkscreen, and they clip and collide at rendered size. In the piano section at 1440x900 the legends read 'Piano section o', 'SUSTPE', 'PSTICK', 'Piano layer A n', 'Timb', 'Uniso', 'String resonan'; the organ LED-ladder captions degrade to stacked fragments 'foo / dra / lev / gra'; in Layer Effects 'Compressor amount' and 'Reverb bright/dark' are overwritten by the row below.
The 'Nord Stage 4 branding' landmark is a blank 133x14 px white plate with the words 'Nord Stage 4 branding' printed under it as a control label — the wordmark itself is not drawn.

Material treatment is credible where it exists: knobs are radial gradients with a rotating pointer index, faders and drawbars have amber LED ladders and a moulded cap, the two OLEDs are green-on-black monospace with a bezel, and the switch caps light red when engaged. Against reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg the deck is missing all of the hardware's boxed sub-panel outlines, category headings and parameter scales, so control clusters read as one flow of identical parts.

Live readouts do work in places: the program OLED tracks the recalled program name ('1.1 Grand Piano' -> '3.2 B3 Organ' -> '4.1 Synth Pad'), the program readout shows P1.1..P1.8 / LIVE, the dirty 'E' appears on the first control edit and clears on Store, switch LEDs follow aria-checked, and faders/knobs render their stored positions.
The transpose readout is stale: after two clicks of T+ the strip still read '0', and after two up plus four down it read '+2'. The engine state and the display disagree.

Displays report state the audio does not have. Stepping the oscillator wave moves the synth OLED through 'Pure 1/0'..'Pure 6/0' and 'Sync 1/0' while the rendered signal is bit-identical (spectral cosine 1.0000); the FX FOCUS LED moves between piano/organ/synth while the knobs keep editing the piano chain; the drawbar numerals fall to 0/1 after any interaction because the control writes a 0..1 value into a field the display reads as 0..8.

The status strip is the worst case: it shows a green ready dot and 'Piano library ready (sample sets + synthesis)' while the AudioContext is suspended at currentTime 0 and no audio can be produced, and it keeps that state after the NaN faults have silenced the engine.

At 390x844 the instrument stays whole and recognisable — the same six sections in order, the red chassis, both OLEDs and the keybed slab are all visible with no clipping and no horizontal page scroll.

It survives by browser zoom-out, not by design: build/index.html ships no viewport meta, so the page lays out at the default 980 px viewport (document.documentElement.scrollWidth 980, scrollHeight 2120) and is scaled to ~0.4. The chassis renders about 700 physical px wide by 175 tall, control hit targets are 8-9 px, and every legend below the section titles is unreadable. All 136 deck controls still pass the elementFromPoint reachability grid, but roughly 600 px of the 844 px viewport is empty background above and below the instrument.
